JavaScript, AJAX, and CSS, coupled with proficiency in Adobe Photoshop.

Android platforms.

in efficient data modeling and retrieval.

interplay between server and client.

Angular projects, executing diverse CRUD operations for efficient data storage.

applications.

proficiency in creating tables, grids, menus, and filters for optimal UI/UX development.

Authentication, Twitter Authentication, and more, in React applications.
• Extensive experience with React on the Frontend, utilizing it as a fast and lightweight cross-platform
framework for building powerful applications.
• Worked on Version Control Systems Visual Source Safe, TFS (Team Foundation Server) and Git for
updating, accessing and managing the code and performed continuous integration.

• HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript, Material UI, Bootstrap, Angular, Ionic.
• Hands on Experience in Unit Testing of Modules using JEST and Cypress. System Testing and collaborated
with end users when User Acceptance Testing (UAT) has been done.
